public_code_research.design: Separate validation failure from a valid no-action decision; source rejects invalid webhook signatures by default.
public_code_research.decision: No SDK dependency or code copied. MIS market-data validation differs from webhook authentication; adopting the SDK cannot fix this local receipt classification.
public_code_research.compatibility: Python>=3.10; JEI can retain existing sender and retry-key guards.
public_code_research.test_method: Nine local/CI invalid MIS CLI receipts must be unverified, never push; verified benign quote remains no_alert.
public_code_research.risk: Does not establish source availability, phone delivery, or repair public index-status publication.
